evidence: Modifies package validation and replacement evaluation logic in src/validation.cpp and src/rpc/mempool.cpp to support package feerate aggregation and RBF checks during dry runs.
rationale: Enables wallets to dry-run 1p1c package acceptance and replacement checks without mutating the mempool. The PR partially resolves issue #32160 by enabling pre-flight evaluation of CPFP fee bumps and sibling eviction, satisfying a clear downstream use case for L2/wallets while remaining reasonably deferrable.
